scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.campaign:publish-progress: esbuild src/cli/publish-artist-campaign-progress.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@google-cloud/storage --external:pino --banner:js='import { createRequire as observerRequire } from "node:module"; const require = observerRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=.local/campaign-progress-observer.mjs && node .local/campaign-progress-observer.mjs
scripts.youtube:publish-progress: esbuild src/cli/publish-youtube-artist-progress.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@google-cloud/storage --external:pino --banner:js='import { createRequire as publisherRequire } from "node:module"; const require = publisherRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=.local/youtube-progress-publisher.mjs && node .local/youtube-progress-publisher.mjs
scripts.youtube:publish-campaign: esbuild src/cli/publish-youtube-campaign-progress.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@google-cloud/storage --external:pino --banner:js='import { createRequire as publisherRequire } from "node:module"; const require = publisherRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=.local/youtube-campaign-observer.mjs && node .local/youtube-campaign-observer.mjs
scripts.test: esbuild tests/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:pino --banner:js='import { createRequire as testRequire } from "node:module"; const require = testRequire(import.meta.url);' --outdir=.local/test-build && node --test .local/test-build/*.test.js
